text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Think nothing of it, a little sleep will set me right!
Just wait a moment.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Now then, Mira-ko, the child of miracles! Let us go dig for "buried treasure"~~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh! Weren't we supposed to have a picnic today!?
And besides, buried treasure...?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Now, now, now!
Show me that miracle of yours!!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Once found...
we can pull strings and lay whatever groundwork we need!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*... Th-There's nothing here at all~
Is it really... supposed to be... here~?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mm!
Believe in miracles!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... No Reason-chan~.
That's just my name... I'm really just an ordinary—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah-wa-wa! M-My knees are...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (THUUUUUMP!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ow! Wait, is there something on my finger—?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh!!! Gold coins, silver coins,
we've struck a gold mine! Well done, Mirako!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I-I really... found it.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
To fall down and find it! What a miracle!
As expected of you, Mirako!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right.
That's true, but... Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: The one who pulled off a miracle was No Reason!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
She pulled me along and cheered me on.
That's why even a lazy person like me could give it my all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Because I managed to make a miracle like this happen!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. That makes me happy,
so I end up going along with it one way or another~.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Mirako...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Thanks for everything as always, No Reason.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're awake. I came to visit~
How are you feeling?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"What, it was just a dream~~?
It was such a wonderful dream, too~~."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...Right! Mirako, we're going for okonomiyaki!
I must reward you for that dream!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: —Eh?
